lessonTitle: Acts Chapter 24 — Paul’s Trial Before Felix

questions.questionText: Five days later the high priest Ananias went down to Caesarea with some elders and a lawyer named whom?
They brought their charges against Paul before whom?
Tertullus began to flatter Felix, saying we have enjoyed a long period of peace under you. He called Paul a what?
options: A troublemaker who stirs up riots among the Jews all over the world

questions.questionText: Tertullus said Paul is a ringleader of the Nazarene sect and even tried to do what?
The other Jews joined in the accusation. When the governor motioned for Paul to speak, Paul said he was glad to make his defense. How many days ago had he gone up to Jerusalem?
True or false: Paul said they did not find him arguing with anyone at the temple or stirring up a crowd.
Paul admitted, I worship the God of our ancestors as a follower of the Way, which they call a sect. He believed everything that agrees with the Law and what?
options: That is written in the Prophets

questions.questionText: Paul said he has the same hope in God as these men themselves have, that there will be a resurrection of both whom?
Paul said he always strives to keep a clear conscience. After an absence of several years he came to bring gifts to the poor and to present offerings. They found him in the temple how?
options: With Greeks inside the sanctuary as proved

questions.questionText: Paul said there was no crowd with him and no disturbance. But there are some Jews from the province of Asia who ought to be here. Or these who are here should state what crime they found when he stood before whom?

Unless it was this one thing I shouted, It is concerning the resurrection of the dead that I am on trial before you today. Then Felix, who was well acquainted with the Way, adjourned the proceedings. Who did he say he would wait for?
He ordered the centurion to keep Paul under guard but give him some freedom and permit his friends to take care of his needs. Several days later Felix came with his wife. What was her name?
Felix sent for Paul and listened to him as he spoke about faith in Christ Jesus. As Paul talked about righteousness, self-control and the judgment to come, Felix was what?
Felix said, When I find it convenient, I will send for you. He was also hoping Paul would do what?
When two years had passed, Felix was succeeded by Porcius Festus, but Felix left Paul in prison. Why?
options: Because Felix wanted to grant a favor to the Jews
Because Caesar ordered it in this verse

questions.questionText: I succeeded Felix as governor. Who am I?
I am the lawyer who accused Paul before Felix. Who am I?
I am Felix’s Jewish wife. Who am I?
True or false: Paul said he went up to Jerusalem to worship no more than twelve days before.
options: True — to start a riot he admitted

questions.questionText: Tertullus called the Way what?
True or false: Felix was well acquainted with the Way.
options: False — he never heard of it
True — so he freed Paul at once

questions.questionText: Felix told Paul he would send for him when he found it what?
How long did Felix keep Paul, hoping for a bribe and talking with him often?
Who went down with Ananias and the elders to accuse Paul?
Paul said he has the same hope that there will be a _____ of both the righteous and the wicked.
True or false: Paul said he always strove to keep a clear conscience before God and man.
options: False — he admitted guilt of riot
True — but he never brought gifts

questions.questionText: Paul came after several years to bring what to his people?
options: Gifts for the poor and to present offerings

questions.questionText: Who should have been there if they had anything against Paul, according to Paul?
options: Some Jews from the province of Asia

questions.questionText: Felix said he would decide the case when which commander comes?
True or false: Paul was given some freedom and friends could take care of his needs.
options: False — he was in a dark pit with no friends
True — he left for Rome that week

questions.questionText: As Paul talked about righteousness, self-control and the judgment to come, Felix became afraid. What did he tell Paul?
options: That’s enough for now! You may leave

questions.questionText: I wanted to grant a favor to the Jews so I left Paul in prison. Who am I?
I am a troublemaker and ringleader, according to Tertullus. Who am I?
The trial before Felix happened in which city?
True or false: Tertullus began with praise of Felix’s peace and foresight.
Paul said he was on trial concerning what hope?
Who often sent for Paul and talked with him during the two years?
I am the new governor after two years. Who am I?
True or false: Paul denied being a follower of the Way.
options: False — he admitted he worshiped as a follower of the Way
True — he said he was a Sadducee
False — he never spoke of the Way

questions.questionText: Paul said they did not find him stirring up a crowd in the synagogues or anywhere in the city. Which city had he gone to worship in?
